deals.offer: Up to $2,000 onboard credit per suite
deals.stay_text: 2027 Alaska and transpacific voyages, featured departures Jun 14 to Sep 19, 2027
deals.details: The credit depends on the voyage and suite. On 2027 Alaska voyages it is $1,000 per suite for Owner's, Concierge, Residential, Luminara, View and Grand Suites and $500 for Signature and Terrace Suites. On the 2027 transpacific voyage it is $2,000 for those higher suite categories and $1,000 for Signature and Terrace Suites. Featured sailings are four 7-night Vancouver to Whittier or Whittier to Vancouver voyages departing June 14, July 6, July 28 and August 20, 2027 (fares from $8,900 to $10,900 per guest) and a 13-night Whittier to Tokyo voyage departing September 19, 2027 (from $7,500 per guest). Exact dates and conditions to be confirmed with the hotel.

deals.name: Rosewood Miyakojima
deals.offer: Up to 25% off the Flexible Rate on two nights or more
deals.details: The Two-Night Escape Offer requires a minimum two-night stay and includes daily breakfast at the restaurant and access to the wellness and fitness facilities. The discount is up to 25% off the Flexible Rate, so the exact percentage may vary by date. No booking deadline is stated.

deals.name: Rosewood Calistoga
deals.offer: Guaranteed upgrade, daily breakfast credit and USD 100 hotel credit
deals.details: Merritt can book 2027 stays at the new Rosewood Calistoga ahead of the public through November 4, 2026. Clients get a guaranteed complimentary room upgrade confirmed at booking (subject to availability), a USD 90 daily breakfast credit and a USD 100 hotel credit. The hotel's opening date and the exact 2027 dates covered are to be confirmed.

deals.name: All participating hotels
deals.offer: Up to 25% off for World of Hyatt members, up to 20% off for everyone else
deals.details: This is the Hyatt Prive Member Offer, so the discounted rate comes with Hyatt Prive benefits on top. World of Hyatt members save up to 25% and need their membership number on the reservation. Everyone else saves up to 20%. Book by December 8, 2026 for stays through April 30, 2027. Only participating hotels are included, so ask Merritt about a specific one.

deals.name: All participating hotels
deals.offer: 30% off Best Available Rate plus a property-specific benefit
deals.details: Rosewood Beyond is the yearly offer for clients who book through Merritt: 30% off Best Available Rate at participating Rosewood hotels, plus one benefit chosen by each property. It can only be booked between November 3 and November 10, 2026, for stays through June 30, 2027. Availability, blackout dates and exclusions apply. Houses, penthouses, villas and apartments are excluded, as are Rosewood Courchevel, Rosewood Calistoga, The Chancery Rosewood and the three New Zealand lodges.

deals.name: The Maybourne Beverly Hills

deals.name: Jumby Bay Island
deals.offer: 10% off best available rate with all-inclusive island inclusions
deals.details: The Island Escape offer gives 10% off the best available rate in any cottage or participating villa on stays of 4 nights or more, booked by Dec 13, 2027 for travel through Dec 16, 2027. The Unlimited Island Inclusions come with it: all-day dining, cocktails, wine and champagne, rum tastings and cooking demonstrations, watersports and sailing, the Kids' Club, fitness facilities and the Racquet Club. Jumby Bay is fully booked Dec 27, 2026 to Jan 1, 2027, with only a few cottages, villas and private estates left for stays departing Dec 26 or earlier.

deals.name: Jumby Bay Island

The Unlimited Island Inclusions are included: all-day dining, cocktails, wine and champagne, rum tastings and cooking demonstrations, watersports and sailing, the Kids' Club, fitness facilities and the Racquet Club.

The Unlimited Island Inclusions come with it: all-day dining, cocktails, wine and champagne, rum tastings and cooking demonstrations, watersports and sailing, the Kids' Club, fitness facilities and the Racquet Club. deals.name: Claridge's
deals.offer: Three-night Christmas package with Christmas lunch and carriage ride
deals.stay_text: Three nights arriving Dec 23 or 24, 2026 only
deals.details: The package is a three-night stay arriving December 23 or 24 only and includes champagne and festive treats on arrival, English breakfast daily, Christmas lunch in Dante Mayfair or the French Salon (drinks not included), a horse-drawn carriage ride around Mayfair, a Claridge's stocking, Christmas morning carols, children's entertainers on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, a visit from Father Christmas and guaranteed 2pm check-out. A Christmas tree in the room is only for Mayfair Suites and above. A 50% non-refundable deposit is due at booking and the balance, also non-refundable, is due November 25, 2026; it is for new bookings only and cannot be combined with other offers, negotiated rates or Virtuoso or preferred partner amenities. Rates include 20% VAT but not the 5% discretionary service charge.

deals.name: The Connaught

A Christmas tree in the room is only for the Coburg Suite and above. A 50% non-refundable deposit is due at booking and the balance, also non-refundable, is due November 25, 2026; new bookings only and not combinable with other offers, negotiated or consortia rates or partner amenities.

deals.details: The credit depends on suite category: $1,000 for Owner's, Concierge and Ilma Suites, $750 for View and Grand Suites, and $500 for Signature and Terrace Suites, with Terrace Suites eligible only on the December 4 and December 11 departures. The credit is per suite based on double occupancy, applies to new bookings made on or after September 25, 2026, can be used for spa, specialty dining and shore excursions booked onboard, and is forfeited if the booking is cancelled or rebooked. No booking deadline is given, and the offer is capacity controlled.
